name: Yogaraja Churnam

sections.reference_sahasrayoga_churna_prakarana_7: Yogaraja Churnam, an Ayurvedic medicine which is available in the form of powder. It is an effective ayurvedic treatment for piles and fistula. It pacifies the vata and kapha doshas in body.
sections.ingredients:
Equal quantities of herbal powders of:- 

 Chitraka (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Pippali Mool – Long pepper root – Piper longum – 
 Yavani (Trachyspermum ammi) 
 Karavi – Piper chaba 
 Ajamoda (Trachyspermum roxburghianum) 
 Jeeraka – Cumin seed 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara) 
 Chavya (Piper cubeba) 
 Ela – Cardamom 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt 
 Kushta (Saussurea lappa) 
 Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata) 
 Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) 
 Dhanyaka – Coriander – 10 grams 
 Triphala – Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Vibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Trikatu – Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger 
 Twak – Cinnamon 
 Usheera (Vetiveria zizanioides) 
 Yavagraja (Hordeum vulgare) – Barley 
 Taleesapatra (Abies webbiana) 
 Patra (Cinnamomum zeylanicum) 
 Guggulu – Purified (Commiphora mukul) 
 Sarpi – ghee – Sufficient Quantity 


 Method of Preparation 
 Crush all the above mentioned ingredients, and make fine powder. Mixed well to form the Yogaraja Churnam.
sections.dosage:
Take 1-3 grams once or twice a day before or after food as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually administered along with honey or warm water.
sections.indications:
Piles 
 Fistula 
 Anorexia 
 Bloating 
 Dyspepsia 
 Rheumatism 
 Asthma 
 Cough 
 Jaundice 
 Anemia
sections.side_effects:
There are no known side effects with this Ayurvedic medicine. 
 Pregnant ladies should avoid oral intake of this product. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Yogaraj Churna 
 Reference: Sahasrayoga Churna Prakarana 71, Rasa Ratna Samuccaya 
 Yogaraja Churnam, an Ayurvedic medicine which is available in the form of powder. It is an effective ayurvedic treatment for piles and fistula. It pacifies the vata and kapha doshas in body. 
 Ingredients 
 Equal quantities of herbal powders of:- 
 
 Chitraka (Plumbago zeylanica) 
 Pippali Mool – Long pepper root – Piper longum – 
 Yavani (Trachyspermum ammi) 
 Karavi – Piper chaba 
 Ajamoda (Trachyspermum roxburghianum) 
 Jeeraka – Cumin seed 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara) 
 Chavya (Piper cubeba) 
 Ela – Cardamom 
 Saindhava Lavana – Rock salt 
 Kushta (Saussurea lappa) 
 Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata) 
 Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) 
 Dhanyaka – Coriander – 10 grams 
 Triphala – Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Vibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Trikatu – Pepper, Long pepper and Ginger 
 Twak – Cinnamon 
 Usheera (Vetiveria zizanioides) 
 Yavagraja (Hordeum vulgare) – Barley 
 Taleesapatra (Abies webbiana) 
 Patra (Cinnamomum zeylanicum) 
 Guggulu – Purified (Commiphora mukul) 
 Sarpi – ghee – Sufficient Quantity 
 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Crush all the above mentioned ingredients, and make fine powder. Mixed well to form the Yogaraja Churnam. 
 Dosage 
 Take 1-3 grams once or twice a day before or after food as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually administered along with honey or warm water. 
 Indications 
 
 Piles 
 Fistula 
 Anorexia 
 Bloating 
 Dyspepsia 
 Rheumatism 
 Asthma 
 Cough 
 Jaundice 
 Anemia 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects with this Ayurvedic medicine. 
 Pregnant ladies should avoid oral intake of this product. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
